content: We have search results but they seem unrelated to TMS protection. The query didn't include bond types correctly. We need template for protecting alcohol with TMSOTf: forward reaction: alcohol + TMSOTf -> TMS ether + TfOH (byproduct). In retrosynthesis, we break O-Si bond to get alcohol and TMSOTf (or TMSCl?). The template likely involves breaking O-Si bond and forming O-H. So we need to search for templates where bonds broken O-Si and formed O-H? Actually forward: O-H broken, O-Si formed. So retrosynthetic: break O-Si, form O-H. So we need template where bonds broken O-Si, bonds formed O-H. Also functional group broken aliphatic hydroxyls. Let's search with bonds_broken O-Si, bonds_formed O-H.
